亲爱的指挥官

=== HUMAN_SUMMARY_BEGIN ===
这是一个15秒的白神凛出门前梳妆场景。白神凛已经穿好工作制服，在洗面台前完成最后整理：先用直发器把头发整理顺直；随后听见玄关远处传来的「行ってきます！」，她停下动作并向玄关方向自然回应「行ってらっしゃい」；最后回到洗面台，用口红完成最后一步妆容。画面始终只出现白神凛；玄关方向的人只通过画外声音存在。Audio 1 对应画外说话者，Audio 2 对应白神凛。
=== HUMAN_SUMMARY_END ===

subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is Shirakami Rin, whose appearance and work uniform come from <Picture 1>.
<Audio 2> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).

<Subject 2> is an off-screen departing household member whose voice is heard from the distant entrance area. No visual identity is shown for <Subject 2>.
<Audio 1> is the voice reference for <Subject 2> (S2).

No other person is visually present.

summary

[reference generation + dual audio reference]

A quiet pre-departure grooming routine of Shirakami Rin.
Already dressed in her work uniform from <Picture 1>, she finishes preparing herself at the washbasin.

She first straightens her hair with a hair straightener.
She then hears an off-screen voice from the distant entrance saying <d>[Japanese]行ってきます！</d>.
She briefly turns her attention toward the entrance and replies <d>[Japanese]行ってらっしゃい</d>.
She then returns her attention to the mirror and applies lipstick as the final grooming action.

retention_analysis

<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - identity, facial appearance, hairstyle, body proportions, and work uniform remain consistent with <Picture 1>.

<Audio 1>: reference - used only for the off-screen departing speaker's voice characteristics and delivery.

<Audio 2>: reference - used only for <Subject 1>'s voice characteristics and delivery.

<Subject 2> remains off-screen throughout the video.
No visual Subject 2 appears in the room, doorway, mirror, reflection, shadow, or background.

The audio sequence is strictly maintained:
<Audio 1> off-screen farewell first, then <Audio 2> spoken response.
The spoken lines must not be swapped between speakers.

detailed_description

[Shot 1]

The scene begins in the washbasin area of Shirakami Rin's home.

<Subject 1> is the only visible person.
She is already fully dressed in the work uniform shown in <Picture 1>.

Use a natural medium composition at normal camera height.
Keep her face, upper body, hands, and the washbasin visible.
The camera remains stable and observational.

At 00:01.000,

<Subject 1> uses a hair straightener on her hair.

She takes a section of hair with one hand.
She closes the heated plates around the section with the other hand.
She smoothly draws the straightener downward along the hair.
The section becomes visibly straighter.

She repeats the motion on another small section of hair.
Her hair gradually becomes neat and straight.

The hair-straightening action finishes before the next event begins.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.500,

<Subject 1> pauses her grooming action when she hears a distant voice from the entrance area.

The voice is heard clearly from outside the visible area:

<Subject 2> (S2), off-screen, says naturally: <d>[Japanese]行ってきます！</d>

No part of <Subject 2> appears on screen.

<Subject 1> stops moving the hair straightener.
She turns her head slightly toward the direction of the distant entrance and briefly acknowledges the voice.

She then replies naturally toward the off-screen entrance using <Audio 2>:

<Subject 1> (S1): <d>[Japanese]行ってらっしゃい</d>

Her delivery is warm and familiar, like a natural farewell at home.

After the line ends, she turns her attention back toward the mirror.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000,

<Subject 1> resumes her final grooming.

She places the hair straightener aside and picks up a lipstick.

She looks at her reflection in the mirror.

She applies the lipstick carefully and evenly to her lips.
The lipstick application is the final grooming action.

She finishes applying the lipstick and briefly checks the result in the mirror.

Her expression remains composed and natural.
She does not suddenly exaggerate her expression or look directly into the camera.

At 00:15.000,

<Subject 1> remains at the washbasin with her hair neatly straightened and her lipstick finished.
The scene ends naturally.

overall_soundscape

Quiet domestic morning ambience.
Subtle sounds from the hair straightener and light fabric movement.
The distant off-screen voice from the entrance clearly says <d>[Japanese]行ってきます！</d>.
<Subject 1> replies clearly with <d>[Japanese]行ってらっしゃい</d> using <Audio 2>.
Soft natural room ambience continues during the lipstick application.
No other voices.

non_diegetic_music

No prominent music.
Keep the scene warm, refined, intimate, and grounded in an ordinary but elegant pre-departure home routine.
